Author: SheepGoMeh
Name: CrowdFix
Description:
Cuts per-frame engine overhead that causes stutter and low FPS, most noticeable in crowded areas.
Spreads culling, skeleton animation and job joins across worker threads, and cuts waits, wake-ups, syscalls and lock contention in the job system and graphics allocator.
Skips work nothing uses: idle GPU resource notifiers, repeated pose syncs, hidden minions' follow AI and hidden hotbar slots.
Adds frame pacing modes for the 1/2 and 1/4 refresh rate limits on VRR and fixed refresh displays.
Each fix can be toggled via /crowdfix
Icon made with AI tools.
Punchline: Smoother frame times by cutting engine overhead.
